title: BPBond 솔로 #137 · 커브드바스트 · Peruvian Nazca painted pattern · 꿇어앉아 앞 바닥 링 · deep glossy red lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Chinese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, demure and soft, cool ash-grey hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern — a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart.

Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
